summary: When Nora thinks before a tool call, the next step of the same task now sees that thinking instead of starting again without it.
details: Background research passes (proactive reminders and room culture) run with reasoning on; until now each step after a tool call was formed without the reasoning that led to the call.
Replies in rooms run with reasoning off and are unchanged.
limitations: Whether this changes what the background passes decide is still being measured.
